heading: Everything your books need, every month
intro: One flat monthly fee. No hourly billing, no surprise invoices at year end.

items.title: Monthly reconciliation
items.description: Every account matched to receipts by the 10th of the following month.

items.title: A named accountant
items.description: One person who knows your books, with replies within a working day.

items.title: Receipt capture
items.description: Snap a photo or forward an email; we file it against the right transaction.

items.title: Quarterly check-ins
items.description: A 30-minute call each quarter to walk through profit and cash flow.

items.title: Works with your bank
items.description: Secure read-only feeds from over 9,000 banks and card providers.

items.title: Year-end handover
items.description: Tax-ready reports delivered to you or your tax preparer by mid-February.
